#!columns text
# text<TAB>direction<TAB>note
# Inputs whose CHANGE OFFSETS are part of the conformance corpus.
# Every other kind of case pins the converted text. These pin `start` and `end`: the
# code-point spans of each change in the OUTPUT, which docs/API.md freezes and which a
# port can get wrong while producing a byte-identical string.
# That is not a hypothetical. Python indexes a str by Unicode code point; JavaScript
# indexes by UTF-16 code unit. The two agree on every Cyrillic letter and part company
# on the first astral character, so a port that slices the output with the offsets it
# was given is correct until someone pastes an emoji, and then silently off by one per
# astral character that precedes the change.
# direction  n2t = Narkamaŭka -> Taraškievica, t2n = the reverse
# Keep this file small. It exists to pin the offset convention, not to re-test
# conversion; the gold set already does that.
# No ZWJ emoji sequence here on purpose. `sanitize` strips U+200D along with the
# other zero-width characters, so 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 arrives as four separate people. That is a
# real defect in the sanitizer, not a property of the offset contract, and pinning
# it here would oblige every port to reproduce it. Tracked separately.
